src: Moporesitente Zuma o tla amogela Motlotlegi, Moporesitente wa Rephaboliki ya Angola, João Lourenço, mo Leeto la Semmuso le le tla dirang hisetori mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa go simolola ka la bo 23 Ngwanaitseele 2017.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u ta sungula riendzo ra ntirho ku nghenelela na ku rhangela Nhlengeletano ya Vumune ya Matikomambirhi ya Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana BNC leyi nga ta khomeriwa eGaborone, eBotswana hi Ravuntlhanu, 17 Hukuri 2017.

src: Dinaga ka bobedi di na le botsalano jwa bogolotala le jwa tirisanommogo fa e sale mo nakong ya fa go ne go kgaratlhelwa kgololesego fa Angola e ne e amogetse le go tshegetsa balwelakgololesego ba Aforika Borwa ba ba neng ba le kwa dikampeng tse di farologaneng kwa nageng eo.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga na Botswana ya hlangana lembe na lembe eka levhele ya Tihloko ta Matiko eka rimba ra BNC ku xopaxopa ntirhisano wa matiko ha vumbirhi na ku kanela timhaka ta ntsakelo wo fana.

src: Kgwebisano le tirisanommogo mo ikonoming magareng ga dinaga ka bobedi e oketsegile go utlwagala, mo ebileng Aforika Borwa e leng mogwebisani yo a di gogang kwa pele wa Angola mo kontinenteng.
tgt: Matiko lamambirhi ya tiphina hi vuxaka bya xinghana lebyi vumbiweke hi ku hlangana ka swa mfuwo na ku va kusuhi na ku kusuhi.

src: Ditlamo di le dintsi tsa Aforika Borwa di dira dikgwebo kwa Angola mo makaleng a a farologaneng a a akaretsang setlamo sa dikago, sa meepo, sa dintlo, sa direkisiwa, sa dijo le dino, sa dihotele le botlhabakgobe, sa ditirelo tsa dibaka le tsa WEBTOKEN leetong la gagwe, Moporesitente Lourenço gape o tla ema ka lefoko phuthego ka Labotlhano, 24 Ngwanaitseele 2017 kwa OR Tambo Building mo Pretoria.
tgt: Ya tirhisana eka timhaka to talanyana leti katsaka, vutleketli, bindzu na vuvekisi, rihanyu, timhaka ta swa mbango sw. sw. Afrika-Dzonga hi rin'wana ra vatirhisani va bindzu lavakulu va Botswana, ku na tikhamphani to hlaya ta Afrika-Dzonga ti nga ri tingani leti tirhaka eka tiko rero.

src: Kabinete e ikamanya le maAforika Borwa a a tsayang dikgato kgatlhanong le pogiso ya basadi le bana.
tgt: Matiko lamambirhi ya na ku hlangana ka xinghana na ka matimu kusukela eka masiku ya ku lwela ntshuxeko loko Anglola ri rhurhele na ku seketela tinhenha ta ku lwela ntshuxeko ta Afrika-Dzonga eka tikamba to hambanahambana etikweni leriya.

src: Ono ke ngwaga wa bo 19 wa letsholo leno mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa mme go tla tswelelwa ka lona ka moono yo o reng: “Mpale: Mmogo re Tsweletsa Pele Aforika Borwa yo o Senang Tirisodikgoka”.
tgt: Ntirhisano wa ikhonomi na bindzu exikarhi ka matiko lamambirhi wu kurile swinene, ku fikela laha Afrika-Dzonga ri nga muringani wa bindzu wo rhanga wa Angola eka tikonkulu.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o tla thankgolola letsholo la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo mo Kapa Botlhaba ka Lamatlhatso, la bo 25 Ngwanaitseele 2017.
tgt: Tikhamphani ta Afrika-Dzonga to tala ti le ku endleni ka bindzu eAngola eka tisekitara to hambanahambana ku katsa na vuako, migodi, tindlu, nxaviso xin'wexin'we, swakudya na swakunwa, tihotela na ku tiphina, vukorhokeri bya swa vutshunguri na byo banga.

src: Le tla tsepamisa mogopolo mo tsweletsong e e sa kgaotseng ya Dipusano tsa Bosetšhaba, e e rotloetsang batho go buisana ka leuba la tirisodikgoka e e totileng batho ba bong jo bo rileng (GBV).
tgt: Hi nkarhi wa riendzo ra yena, Phuresidente Lourençou u ta tlhela a fambisa Dyondzo hi Ravuntlhanu, 24 Hukuri 2017 eka Muako wa OR Tambo ePitori.

src: Lefapha la Bosiamisi le Tlhabololo ya Molaotheo le tla tsaya letsholo la bobedi la diyalemowa tsa baagi ka setlhogo sa yona sa Tla re Bueng ka Bosiamisi, leo le tlisang ditirelo tsa puso kwa baaging ka go neela bareetsi tšhono ya go buisana badiredipuso ka dintlha tse di kwa setlhoeng.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo lawa ya teka goza ro lwa na ku xanisiwa ka vavasati na vana.

src: Go thankgolowla ga Kgotlatshekelo ya Dikgetse tsa Tlolomolao ya Thobalano mo nakong ya letsholo leno go tla netefatsa gape gore go nna bonolo go fitlhelela thulaganyo ya bosiamisi.
tgt: Pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na Madzolonga ehenhla ka Vavasati na Vana ri ta va kona exikarhi ka ti 25 Hukuri na 10 N'wendzamhala 2017.

src: Kabinete e na le tshepo e e tletseng gore ka go dirisana mmogo re ka fedisa dipogisego.
tgt: Leri i lembe ra vu 19 ra pfhumba eAfrika-Dzonga naswona ri ta ya emahlweni ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Na Mina Ndzi Hlaye: Swin'we hi Yisa Emahlweni Afrika-Dzonga ro Pfumala Madzolonga”.

src: Itukisetso ya Letsatsi la Lefatshe ka ga AIDKabinete e ipiletsa mo go botlhe mo setšhabeng go tsaya karolo mo Labotlhanong wa Lente le le Khibidu go goteletsa kwa pele Letsatsi la Lefatshe ka ga AIDS ka la bo 1 Sedimonthole go fitlha kwa bokhutlhong jwa kgwedi eo.
tgt: Phuresidente Zuma u ta simeka pfhumba ra Masiku ya 16 yo Lwisana na madzolonga eKapa Vuxa hi Mugqivela, 25 Hukuri 2017.

src: Go apara lente le le khibidu ke sesupo sa tshwaraganelo le maikemisetso a go lwantsha HIV le AIDLetsatsi la Lefatshe ka ga AIDS ke tšhono ya baagi botlhe go tshwaragana mo go lwantsheng HIV, ba bontshe tshegetso ya bao ba tshelang ka HIV le go gopola bao ba hulereng ka ntlha ya yona.
tgt: Ri ta kongomisa eka ku yisiwa emahlweni ka ku sunguriwa ka n'wangulano wa Rixaka, leyi khutazaka vanhu ku vulavula hi mayelana na ntungu wa madzolonga ya ku ya hi rimbewu.

src: Mokete wa monongwaga o tla tshwarwa ka moono: “Ke Tshwanelo ya Me go Itse Seemo sa Me, Go Thibela Ketegelo ke Maikarabelo a Me”, o o golaganeng le moono wa lefatshe ka bophara o o reng: “Ke Tshwanelo ya Me go Iponela Ditirelo tsa Boitekanelo”.
tgt: Leswi swi ta landzeriwa hi Siku ra Vavanuna ra Matiko hinkwawo hi Sonto, 19 Hukuri 2017, leri rhambaka vavanuna ku tlanga xiphemu xa vona eku akeni muganga lowu hlayisekeke na vun'we bya vanhu.

src: Tsenngotirisong eno e e bonatla ya Leano la Togamaano ya Bosetšhaba (NSP) ka HIV, Lehuba le Malwetse a Phetelano ka Thobalano la 2017 - 2022 la Aforika Borwa, leo le leng botlhokwa mo kgatelong pele ya Aforika Borwa mo go fitlheleleng tlhokomelo ya boitekanelo ya batho botlhe jaaka go tlhalositswe mo go NDP, eo e rotloetsang gore go nne le baagi ba ba tshelang ka boitekanelo, ba ba nang le matla e bile ba lekalekana.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Vululami na Nhluvukiso wa Vumbiwa yi ta fambisa pfhumba ra rhadiyo ra muganga ra vumbirhi ehansi ka minongonoko ya A hi Vulavuleni ku Lulama, leri tisaka vukorhokeri bya mfumo eka vanhu hi ku nyika vayingiseri nkateko wo tihlanganisa na vaofisiri eka timhaka leti nga emahungwini.

src: Ka boeteledipele jwa GCIS, serala seno se rotloetsa dikgolagano tsa dipuisano magareng ga ditokololo tsa khuduthamaga le baagi.
tgt: Khabinete ya tshemba leswaku hi ku tirhisana hi nga herisa ndzhendzheleko wa nxaniso.

src: E diragala ka nako ya mekete ya ngwagakgolo wa Oliver Reginald Tambo, yo a neng a lwela tekatekano ya batho ba bong jo bo sa tshwaneng.
tgt: Hi ku hlangana ka matshalatshala ya hina hi nga tirha ku sivela nxaniso loko hi karhi hi tiyisisa muganga lowu hlayisekeke eka vamanana na vana.

src: Ditiragalo tseno maitlhomo a tsona ke go tshegetsa Letsholo la Matsatsi a le 16 a Bolweladitshwanelo.
tgt: Vanhu hinkwavo eAfrika-Dzonga va khutaziwa ku ambala rhibono yo basa tanihi mfungho wa ku tiboha ku herisa ntungu lowu ku suka emigangeni ya hina.

src: Maitlhomo ke go simolola thulaganyo mo maemong a bosetšhaba le a porofense go senka maikutlo gore go diriwe diphetogo mo melelwaneng ya porofense tebang le Masepala wa Selegae wa Matatiele kwa Kapa Botlhaba mmogo le kwa mafelong a mangwe a Ba Ga Mothibi kwa Bokone Bophirima.
tgt: Ku ambala rhibono yo tshuka i mfungho wa vun'we na ku tiboha ku lwa na HIV na AIDSiku ra AIDS ra Misava i nkateko eka muganga wun'wana na wun'wana ku hlangana eka ku lwa na HIV, ku kombisa nseketelo eka vanhu lava hanyaka na HIV na ku tsundzuka lava hundzeke emisaveni.

src: Maikemisetso a go lebelelwa sešwa melelwane ya porofense a tlhagelela ka ntlha ya fa baagi ba dikarolo tsa dinaga tse di umakilweng ba batla go wela kwa diporofenseng tsa baagisani.
tgt: Nkhuvo wa lembe leri wu ta endliwa ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Mfanelo ya Mina ku Tiva Xiyimo xa Mina, Nsivelo I Vutihlamuleri bya Mina”, lowu khomanaka na nkongomelo wa matiko hinkwawo: “Mfanelo eka Rihanyu”.

src: Kabinete e akgotse Fora go bo e le naga e e atlenegisitsweng go ka tshwarela kwa go yona Sejana sa Lefatshe tsa Rakabi sa 2023 mme e leboga boemedi jwa puso, jo bo neng bo eteletswe pele ke Motlatsamoporesitente Cyril Ramaphosa, Tona ya Metshameko le Boitapoloso Thulas Nxesi mmogo le Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika Borwa wa Rakabi, ka tiro e e dirilweng mo go tsholetseng maiteko a Aforika Borwa a go ka tshwarela meletlo eo kwano.
tgt: Leswi swi tiyisisa nsimeko wa Kungu ra swa Maqhinga ra HIV ya Rixaka ra Afrika-Dzonga, vuvabyi bya rifuva na Mavabyi ya Ntlulelo wa swa Masangu 2017 - 2022 (NSP), leswi ku nga phuphu ya nkoka eka nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga ku yisa eku fikeleleni nhlayiso wa rihanyu wa misava hinkwayo hilaha swi kombisiweke hakona eka NDP, leswi tlakusaka rixaka leri hanyeke kahle, ro tiya na ku va na ndzingano swinene.

src: Kabinete e akgotse Tona Pandor, yo a abetsweng Kabo ya Morutabaithuti yo o Diphatsa.
tgt: Ehansi ka vurhangeri bya GCIS, ndlela leyi yi tlakusa n’wangulano exikarhi ka Swirho swa Huvonkulu na miganga.

src: Kabo eno e neetswe Tona Pandor, ke Molaodi wa Yunibesiti ya Aforika Borwa, Moporesitente wa mo malobeng rre Thabo Mbeki.
tgt: Yi ta va kona eka rimba ra malembe xidzana ya Oliver Reginald Tambo, loyi a seketeleke ndzingano wa rimbewu.

src: Kapinete e tshwere kopano ya yona ya bofelo ya ngwaga wa 2017 kwa Union Buildings mo Pretoria.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile ro hetelela eka 2017 eUnion Buildings ePitori.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Togamaano ya Bosetšhaba ya Lekala la Bojanala (NTSS) 2016-2026 gore e ka tsenngwatirisong.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Qhinga ra Sekithara ra Vupfhumba ra Rixaka (NTSS) 2016-2026 ku va ri simekiwa.

src: NTSS e tlhalosiwa ka dipilara tsa togamaano di le tlhano e leng ya phasalatso, tolamiso ya go nolofatsa phitlhelelo ya bojanala, go oketsa boitumelo jwa bajanala, taolo ya lefelo le go iwang kwa go lona mmogo le go anamisa dipoelo tse kgolo.
tgt: NTSS yi yima hi tiphuphu ta maqhinga ta ntlhanu , ku nga ku maketa, ku fambisa mfikelelo wo olova eka vapfhumba, ku antswisa ntokoto wa vaendzi, mafambiselo ya tindhawu ta vuendzi na mivuyelo ya endleloangarhelo.

src: Tokomane e e feletseng e teng mo webesaeteng ya Lefapha la Bojanala ya: www.
tgt: Tsalwa hinkwaro ri kona eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Vupfhumba: WEBTOKEKhabinete yi pasisile rimba ra ku tumbuluxiwa ka Khamphani ya Netiweke ya Broadband ya Rixaka.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse letlhomeso la go tlhoma Setlamo sa Naga sa Neteweke ya Porotebente.
tgt: Leswi swi ta fambisa ku sunguriwa ka swilo leswi nga ni vuxaka na ku fambisa hi ndlela yo hlanganela na ku tumbuluxa vurhangeri bya broadband ya rixaka.

src: Se tla tlhamiwa ka go kopanya Sentech le Broadband Infraco.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Xiviko xa ku Humelela xa Lembe na lembe xo Sungula eka ku Simekiwa ka Mpfapfarhuto wa tirhele wa Timfanelo ta Vanhu lava hanyaka na Vutsoniwa (WPRPD).

src: Seno se tla laola go tsenngwatirisong ga mananeo ano a a tshegetsaneng ka tsela e e rulagantsweng le go tlhoma mofenyi wa naga wa porotebente.
tgt: Xiviko xi angarhela nkarhi wa ku suka hi ti1 Sunguti ku fika hi ti 31 N'wendzamhala 2016.Xiviko xi nyika vuhleri bya xiyimo xa le henhla xa hilaha tindzawulo ta mfumo ti nga sungula ku nghenelerisa swileriso swa pholisi ya WPRPD eka makunguhatelo, mapimanyetelo, na mphakelo wa vukorhokeri na maendlelo ya ku vika ya tona.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse Pegelo ya Ntlha ya Dikgatelopele ya Ngwaga le Ngwaga e e ka ga go tsenngwatirisong Lokwalotemoso lwa Lefapha la Puso ka ga Ditshwanelo tsa Batho ba ba Nang le Bogolofadi (WPRPD).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Rimba ra Maqhinga ya Pholisi ya Vatsoniwa eka Tidyondzo ta le Henhla na Maendlelo ya Vuleteri leswaku ku rhumeriwa swibumabumelo.

src: Pegelo eno e akaretsa paka e e simolotseng ka la bo 1 Ferikgong go fitlha ka la bo 31 Sedimonthole 2016.Pegelo eno e tlhagisa tekolo ya maemo a a kwa godimo mo ebileng mafapha a puso a setseng a simolotse go tsenyeletsa ditaelo tsa pholisi eno ya WPRPD mo maanong a bona, mo ditekanyetsokabong le mo dithulaganyong tsa le tsa kaboditirelo le tsa go dira dpegelo.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlamuseriwile hi mivuyelo ya Nkambisiso wa Phurogireme ya ku Herisa Mathekisi loku nga endliwa ku suka hi Hukuri 2015 ku fika Ndzati 2016.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse phasalatso ya Pholisi ya Letlhomeso la Togamaano ya Bogolofadi go samagana le Thulaganyo ya Thuto le Katiso ya Morago ga go Konosetsa Dithuto tsa Sekolo (PSET) gore baagi ba dire ditshwaelo.
tgt: Phurogireme i xiphemu xo angarhela xa Qhinga ra Vutleketli bya Vaaki, leri lavaka ku fikelerisa sisiteme ya vuhlayiseki byo hlanganela na vutleketli lebyi pfunaka eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Kabinete e nopoletswe ka dipoelo tsa Tshekatsheko ya Lenaane la Tlhabololo ya Dithekesi le le diragaditsweng go simolola ka Ngwanaitseele 2015 go fitlha ka Lwetse 2016.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile tinhlengeletano to tala na ntirho wo tala wu fanele ku endliwa na tindzawulo leti nga fanela loko Ndzawulo ya Vutleketli ya Rixaka yi nga si sungula ku pfuxeta maendlelo.

src: Lenaane leno ke karolo ya togamaano e kgolo ya Togamaano ya Dipalangwa tsa Baagi, eo maitlhomo a yona e leng go tlhagisa thulaganyo ya dipalangwa e e dirang sentle e bile e babalesegile e e kopanetsweng mo Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku humesiwa ku ya eka vaaki ka nkandziyiso wa vu 8 wa Swikombo swa Nhluvukiso swa (2016).

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse gore go diriwe dipuisano le tiro e e tseneletseng le mafapha a a maleba pele Lefapha la Naga la Dipalangwa le ka samagana le kgato e e ntšhwafaditsweng.
tgt: Xiviko xa Xikombo xa Nhluvukiso xi langutisa eka nhluvukiso wa Afrika-Dzonga ku sukela loko ku ri na xidemokirasi na ku landzelerisa ku simekiwa ka Kungu ra Nhluvukiso wa Rixaka: Xivono xa Khabinete yi pasisile tindlela ta ku tiyisisa mafambiselo ya matikhomelo ya vatirhelamfumo loko swi ta eka vatirhi lava endlaka bindzu na marhavi ya mfumo.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go phasaladiwa mo baaging ga kgatiso ya bo robedi ya Ditshupetso tsa Kgatelopele (tsa 2016).
tgt: Swi cinca Swinawana swa Vatirhelamfumo swa 2016, leswi alelaka vatirhelamfumo ku endla bindzu na Mfumo.

src: Pegelo ya Ditshupetso tsa Kgatelopele e tsepamisitse mogopolo mo tlhabololong ya Aforika Borwa fa e sale go nna le temokerasi mme e ela tlhoko go tsenngwatirisong ga Leano la Tlhabololo la Bosetšhaba (NDP): Ponelopele ya Kabinete e atlenegisitse dikgato tse di tla matlafatsang taolo ya dikgato tsa kgalemo ya badiredipuso mabapi le badiredipuso ba ba gwebisanang le ditheo tsa puso.
tgt: Ku sukela hi ti1 Nyenyankulu, Nkwama wa Mfumo, hi ku seketeriwa hi Ndzawulo ya Vatirhelamfumo na Vulawuri (DPSA), va ta landzelerisa mitsariso yintshwa eka Nhlayisa-switiviwa ya Vaphakeri ya le Xikarhi eka Sisiteme ya Phesali.

src: E tswa mo Melawaneng ya Ditirelo tsa Puso ya 2016, e e thibelang badiredipuso go gwebisana le Puso.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Mafambiselo ya Matirhelo Yantshwa na Sisiteme ya Nhluvukiso wa Tinhloko ta Tindzawulo, leswi kombaka nkahoxeko ku hlangana exikarhi ka matirhelo ya munhu na matirhelo ya nhlangano.

src: Go simolola ka la bo 1 Mopitlwe, Lefapha la Matlotlo a Naga, le tshegeditswe ke Lefapha la Bodiredipuso le Tsamaiso (DPSA), ba tla lekola boikwadiso jotlhe jo bo diragadiwang mo Sefalanakgobokgobotshedimosong sa Baabiditirelo (CSD) gore baikwadisi bao ga ba tlhagelele gape mo thulaganyong ya Persal.
tgt: Leswi swi ta sungula ku tirha hiti1 Dzivamisoko Khabinete yi pasisile ku sunguriwa na ku simekiwa ka Rimba ra Xikimi xa ku Thola Vatirhelamfumo lava Thwaseke.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse gore Thulaganyo e Ntšhwa ya Tlhabololo ya Bolaodi jwa Tiragatsotiro ya Ditlhogo tsa Lefapha, e e bontshang ka tolamo kgolagano magareng ga tiragatsotiro ya batho le ya mokgatlho o ba o direlang.
tgt: Leswi swi vumba xiphemu xa phurogireme ya nhluvukiso eka Vatirhelamfumo ku kota ku koka rinoko eka mathwasana lawa ya nga na vuswikoti eka Vutirhelamfumo.

src: E tla simolola go tsenngwatirisong ka la bo 1 Moranang Kabinete e atlenegisitse go tsenngwatirisong ga Letlhomeso la Sekema sa go Thapiwa ga Dialogane mo Ditirelong tsa Puso.
tgt: Rimba ri katsa ku languta phesente ya ndzawulo yin'wana na yin'wana laha ku nga na swivandla swa mitirho ku kota thola mathwasana eka mitirho leyi kaleriwaka hi mathwasana.

src: Seno ke karolo ya lenaane la tlhabololo mo Ditirelong tsa Puso go ka ngokela dialogane tse di nang le bokgoni go ka direla puso.
tgt: Holobye wa Vutirhelamfumo na Vulawuri u ta tlhela a xaxameta rimba leri na Phurogireme ya Vukorhokeri bya ku Thola Vantshwa.

src: Letlhomeso leno le akaretsa go nopola phesente e e rileng ya diphatlhatiro tsa lefapha le lengwe le le lengwe gore e tswalelwe ke dialogane mo ditirong tseo go nang le tlhaelo ya batho ba ba dirang mefuta eo ya tiro.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hangalasiwa ka Switiviso leswi landzelaka eka Gazete ya Mfumo leswi fambelenaka na ku Kongomisa Swiboho swa Huvo eka Mindzilekano, leswi xikongomelo ku nga ku tlakusa mfikelelo eka vululami eka lava khale a va siyiwile ehandle na le ka matikoxikaya lawa a ya nga korhokeriwi hi ku ringanela.

src: Tona ya DPSA o tla lepalepanya gape letlhomeso leno le Lenaane la Tirelo ya go Thapiwa ga Bašwa.
tgt: Ku kongomisiwa swi le ka miganga ya majisitarata wa le Free State na le Kapa-N'walungu, na ku susuwa ka Miganga yin'wana ya Majisitarata ku suka eka Rhavi ra Gauteng ra Huvo ya le Henhla na ku ti veka ehansi ka ndzilekana wa Rhavi ra Huvo ya le Henhla ra N'walungu-Vupeladyambu.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse gore go phasaladiwe Dikitsiso tse di latelang mo Kaseteng ya Puso tse di amanang le Dikamano tsa Melao ya Dikgotlatshekelo, tseo maitlhomo a tsone e leng go tokafatsa phitlhelesego ya bosiamisi mo go bao mo malobeng ba neng ba kgapetswe kwa thoko le mo metseng e e kwa metseselegaeng eo e sa direlweng ka botlalo.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Swipimelo eka Milawu ya Vulamuri hi ku ya hi Nawu wa ku Sirhelela Vuvekisi, 2015 (Nawu wa 22 wa 2015).

src: Go tla potlakisiwa dikgaolo tsa magiseterata kwa Foreistata le kwa Kapa Bokone, le go ntshiwa ga Dikgaolo tse dingwe tsa Magiseterata mo Kgaolong ya Gauteng go tswa ka fa diphukeng tsa Kgotlatshekelokgolo go di tsenya ka fa tlase ga diphuka tsa bosiamisi jwa Kgaolo ya Kgotlatshekelokgolo ya Bokone Bophirima.
tgt: Swinawana swi fikelerisa muvekisi loyi a nga na mikanetano hi ku ya hi xiboho lexi tekiweke hi mfumo lexi khumbhaka vuvekisi, ku kombela Ndzawulo ya Mabindzu na Vumaki (dti) ku nghenelela hi tindlela leti kotekaka ta vulamuri.

src: Melawana eno e thusa mobeeletsi yo a nang le ngongora ka kgato e e tserweng ke puso mme e ama peeletso, go kopa Lefapha la Kgwebisano le Intaseteri (dti) go ka tsereganya ka mekgwa eo maitlhomo e leng go tsereganya.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku hlangana na ku rhurheriwa ka tikhonferense leti landzelaka: Khonferense yo Tihlanganisa ya Phurogireme ya Nhluvukiso wa Vatirhi va Muganga va Rixaka ya 2018 hi DPSKhonferense ya Lembe na Lembe ya vu 23 ya Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava ya Vachuchisi, leyi nga ta rhurheriwa hi Vulawuri bya Vachuchisi bya Rixaka eDurban hi Ndzati 2018.

src: Khonferense e e Tshwarwang Ngwaga le Ngwaga ya bo 23 ya Mokgatlho wa Boditšhabatšhaba wa Basekisi, e e tla tshwarwang ke Bothati jwa Bosekisi jwa Bosetšhaba (NPA) kwa Durban mo pakeng ya Lwetse 2018.Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense mo Aforika Borwa ka 2021.
tgt: 2021 Foramu ya Sayense ya Misava eAfrika-Dzonga.

src: Lefapha la Saense le Thekenoloji le tla buisana le Bolaodi jwa Komiti ya Foramo ya Lefatshe ya Saense go buisanela kgonagalo ya gore e ka tshwarelwa fano gae.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji yi ta burisana na Komiti ya Vufambisi eka Foramu ya Sayense ya Misava loko swikoteka ku va yi rhurhela.

src: Puisanelo ya Maemo a a kwa Godimo ya 2017 ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU), e e tshwerweng ke DPSA go simolola gompieno ka la bo 6 go fitlha ka la bo 8 Sedimonthole 2017.
tgt: 2017 N’wangulano wa Xiyimo xa le Henhla xa Nhlangano wa Afrika (AU), lowu nga ta rhurheriwa hi DPSA ku sukela hi ti 6 ku fika hi ti 8 N'wendzamhala 2017.

src: Kabinete e amogetse go betliwa ga madi a tshipi a go bontsha tlotlo a a ka bokelediwang le a a tla dirisediwang go reka gore a rebolwe ka 2018.Mebetlo ya madi ano a tshipi, le seo a se buang, di tla gatisiwa mo Kaseteng ya Puso:Madi a 2018 a di onse di le 2, ka dikharate di le 22 tsa gauta a ranta ya KrugerMadi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a Natura ka dikharate di le 24 tsa gauta (Go Tsoga ga dikgolomodumo – Archosauria)Madi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a R1 ka dikharate di le 24 tsa gauta (Digagabi tsa naga ya Aforika Borwa – khudu)Madi a 2018 a a bopilweng ka motswako wa ditshipi di le pedi a R5 a a tla dirisediwang go reka (Ngwagakgolo wa Nelson Mandela)Madi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a Protea a dikharate di le 24 tsa gauta le selefera o o opafaditsweng a (Botshelo jwa Mogaka – Nelson Mandela)Madi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a R2 wa Korone le 2 ½ waTiki a selefera o o opafaditswenga (Ditlhagisiwa tsa Boitlhamedi tsa Aforika Borwa tsa Didirisiwa tsa khomphiuthara tsa go dirisa maphotho a pono go bona foo go sa bonagaleng) mmogo leMadi a 2018 a lethathama la madi a tshipi a a kgabisitsweng a selefera o o opafaditsweng(Polokelo ya tsa Tlhago ya Dinonyane le Malomo a Waterberg).
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile tidizayini na nhlengeleto wa ku tsundzuka na ku hangalasiwa ka mali ya nsimbhi leyi nga ta humesiwa hi 2018.Tidizayini ta mali ya nsimbhi, na ku tivisiwa ka tona, swi ta kandziyisiwa eka Gazete ya Mfumo: 2018 ku hangalasiwa ka mali ya R5 ya tinsimbhi timbirhi (Lembexidzana ra Nelson Mandela)2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku ta nongonoko wa R1 (Mikolombyani ya Afrika-Dzonga, pheroto yi jovote futsu)2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku eka nongonoko mali ya nsimbi ya Nachura (Ku tlakuka ka dayinasoro - Archosauria)2018 2oz, 22 wa tikharete ta nsuku ta randi ya Kruger 2018 24 wa tikharete ta nsuku na silivhere yo vangama ya mali ya nongonoko wa mali ya Phurothiya (Vutomi bya Nhenha -Nelson Mandela)2018 wa silivhere yo vangama ya Harhi ya R2 na 2 ½ wa nongonoko wa Tiki (Vutumbuluxi bya Afrika-Dzonga - vukombisi bya xithekiniki hi Khomphyuta) na2018 silivhere yo vangama ya nongonoko lowu nga totiwa muhlovo (Tinyenyani na Swiluva swa Ntanga wa Swimilani wa Waterberg).Xiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: Dipoelo tsa Seelosotlhe sa Ditlhagisiwa tsa Naga mo Ngwageng (GDP)Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke kgolo ya ikonomi ya Aforika Borwa e e godileng ka 2% mo ngwageng mo kotareng ya boraro mo ngwageng wa 2017, go tswa mo palong e e fetotsweng e e neng e le kwa godimo ya 2.8% mo kotareng ya bobedi.
tgt: Mivuyelo ya Swimakiwa Hinkwaswo swa TikoKhabinete yi tsakile hi ku kula ka ikhonomi ya Afrika-Dzonga leyi kuleke hi ku hlayiwa hi lembe hi 2% eka kotara ya vunharhu ya 2017, ku suka eka mpfuxeto wa le henhla wa 2.8% eka kotara ya vumbirhi.

src: Tiragatsotiro e e thata go feta e e neng e solofetswe eno e ne e ikaegile bogolosegolo ka kgolo e e neng e ntse e tsweletse go gola mo lekaleng la temothuo, leo le tlametseng ka seabe sa karolo ya diphesente ya go fitlha mo kgolokakaretsong ya mo morago ga 44.2% mo kotareng e nngwe le e nngwe.
tgt: Matirhelo lawa ya nga tiya lawa ku tlula lawa a ya languteriwile ya vile kona hi mhaka ya ku kula loku ya ka emahlweni eka sekithara ya vurimi, leyi nga hoxa xandla eka wa tiphesente eka ku kula hinkwako endzhaku ka 44.2% eka kotara hi kotara ya ku kula.

src: Tiragatsotiro e e matlafetseng eno mo temothuong, e e tlhagisitseng dikotara di le tharo tse di latelaneng tsa kgolo, e dirilwe ke kotulo e e kwa godimo ya dijalo (tse di jaaka mmidi) mo mafelong a a tshologelwang ke dipula mo selemong le mo ditlhagisweng tse di somarelwang.
tgt: Matirhela ya kahle ya vurimi, laha hi nga vona tikotara tinharhu ta ku kula ka xiyimo xa le henhla, swi vile kona hi ntshovelo wa le henhla wa swirimiwa (yo fana na mavele) eka tindhawu ta mpfula ya ximumu na swirimiwa swa swo xavisiwa.

src: Makala a meepo le a tlhagisodikuno le one a latlhetse tlhwarelegonnyane mo kgolong e e nopotsweng, ka meepo le lenkwari di oketsegile ka 6.6% le go nna le seabe sa karolo ya diphesente ya mo kgolong.
tgt: Migodi na vutumbuluxi swi hoxile xandla eka kula loku nga rhikhodiwa, laha migodi na ku ceriwa ka maribye swi nga kula hi 6.6% na ku hoxa xandla hi 0.5% wa tipoyinti eka ku kula.

src: Lekala la motlakase ke lone le le nnileng bodipa go gaisa, ka go wela tlase ka 5.5%.
tgt: Sekithara ya gezi hi yona yi nga lahlekeriwa swinene, yi yile ehansi hi 5.5%.

src: Kgolo ya dijo tsa kwa malapeng ya 2.6% ke ka ntlha ya go reka ditlhagisiwa tse di sa senyegeng, tseo di nnileng le seabe sa karolo ya diphesente ya mo kgolong ya 2.6%.
tgt: Ku kula eka switirhisiwa swa le ndyangwini hi 2.6% swi vile kona hi mhaka ya ku xaviwa ka tinhundzu leti nga tiya, leti nga endla 1.6% wa tipoyinti ta ku kula ka 2.6%.

src: Kgolo e e matla go fete e e neng e solofetswe le koketsego mo kotareng ya bobedi dipoelo tsa kgolo di ra gore kgolo e ka fitlhelela 0.9% ka 2017.Seno ke go feta 0.7% e e neng e solofetswe fa go ne go diriwa Puo ya Pholisi ya Tekanyetsokabo ya Kgweditharo (MTBPS).
tgt: Ku kula ko tlula loku nga languteriwa na ku ya ehenhla ka mpfuxeto eka kotara ya vumbirhi ya mbuyelo swivula leswaku ku kula ku nga fika eka 0.9% hi 2017.Leswi swi le henhla hi 0.7% eka leswi a swi languteriwile hi nkarhi wa Xitatimende xa Pholisi ya Mpimanyeto wa Theme ya le Xikarhi.

src: Puso e tshwanetse go netefatsa gore lebelo leno la kgolo le a somarelwa ka go tswelela go tsenya tirisong dikgato di le 14 tse di tlhotlheletsang boitshepelo tse di agelelang mo boitshepelong jwa moreki le go dira gore dikgwebo le tsone di nne le boitshepelo.
tgt: Mfumo wu fanele ku tiyisisa leswaku matimba ya ku kula ku ya emahlweni ku tshama ku ri kona hi ku yisa emahlweni ku simeka tindlela ta 14 ta ku tlakusa ku tshemba leti yisaka ehenhla ku tshemba ka vatirhisi naswona ku nga vuyerisa ku tshemba ka mabindzu.

src: Lefelo la ditirelontsi la InvestSAKabinete e amogetse go thankgololwa ga Lefelo la Ditirelontsi la InvestSA la kwa KwaZulu-Natal ke Moporesitente Jacob Zuma jaaka karolo ya maitlhomo a go tokafatsa bonolo jwa go dira kgwebo mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: InvestSA One-Stop ShopKhabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka InvestSA One-Stop Shop eKwazulu-Natal hi Phuresidente Jacob Zuma tanihi xiphemu xa ku antswisa ku endla bindzu na Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Leno ke Lefelo la Ditirelontsi la boraro le le thankgolotsweng mo nageng.
tgt: Loku i ku simekiwa ka vunharhu laha tikweni.

src: Maitlhomo a lona ke go dira tikologo e e lokologileng ka go tlhoma setlhongwa se se ka totiwang mabapi le babeeletsi gore ba iponele ditirelo tsotlhe, go latedisa diporojeke le go fokotsa dikgoreletso tsa puso tse di leng teng fa o itshimololela kgwebo.
tgt: Leyi lavaka ku endla leswaku ku va na mbangu wa kahle wa ku fikelerisa nkongomelo wa vuhlanganisi eka vavekisi ku kuma vukorhokeri hi ku hatlisisa tiphurojeke na ku hunguta vuyimayima loko u sungula bindzu.

src: Botsalano jwa Aforika Borwa le AngolaKabinete e amogetse tumelano e e saenilweng mo leetong la semmuso mo Aforika Borwa la Moporesitente wa Angola João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.
tgt: Vuxaka bya Afrika-Dzonga na AngolaKhabinete yi amukela ntwanano lowu nga sayiniwa hi nkarhi wa Riendzo ra Tiko hi Phuresidente wa Angola João Manuel Gonçalves Lourenço.

src: Ditumelano tse di latelang di saenetswe: Mmemorantamo wa Ditumelano (MoU) o o ka ga go tlhama Khomišene ya Diporesitente tsa Dinagapedi, MoU o o ka ga Tirisano mo Mererong ya Tikologo, Ditshupetsotsela tsa Tsenngotirisong mabapi le go tlhokomologa Visa, Thulaganyo ya Tirisano ya Sepodisi mmogo le Tumelano ka ga go Utlwanela go Thusana mo go tsa Botsamaisi mo Mererong ya tsa Lekgetho.
tgt: Mitwanano leyi landzelaka yi sayiniwile: Memorandamu ya Ntwanano (MoU) eka ku tumbuluxiwa ka Khomixini ya Matiko hayambirhi ya va Phuresidente, MoU eka Ntirhisano eka Xiyenge xa Mbango, Nsimeko wa Swiletelo swa ku nga tirhisi vhisa, Maendlelo eka Ntirhisano wa Maphorisa na Ntwanano eka Mpfuno wa Vulawuri bya Milawu ya Timhaka ta Xibalo xa tinhundzu leti tlulaka mindzilekana.

src: Samiti ya Botlhano ya Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Yuropa (EU) le Mokgatlhotshwaraganelo wa Aforika (AU)kabinete e amogetse dipoelo tsa Samiti ya Botlhano ya EU le ASamiti eno e neelane ka tšhono ya gore Aforika Borwa e gagamatse botsalano jwa yona jwa togamaano mo ikonoming le mo botipolomateng ka dipuisanelo tse di farologaneng mo samiting le mo meketeng e e jaaka Formao ya Bogwebi le Samiti ya Bašwa ka tsepamisomogopolo e e ikaegileng ka kgodiso ya ikonomi, go thapiwa ga bašwa mmogo le mo boitlhamedikgwebong.
tgt: Samiti ya Vuntlhanu ya Nhlangano wa AU-Yuropo (EU).Khabinete yi amukela mivuyelo ya vuntlhanu ya Samiti ya AU-ESamiti yi fikelerisile xivandlanene eka Afrika-Dzonga ku yisa emahlweni vuxaka bya xidipilomati na maqhinga ya ikhonomi hi ku burisana ko hambanahambana eka samiti na le ka mitlangu ya le tlhelo yo fana na Foramu ya Mabindzu na Vantshwa, leyi nga kongoma eka ku kula ka ikhonomi loku katsaka, ku thoriwa ka vantshwa na mabindzu.

src: Go gweba ka bana ba mmala wa sebilo jaaka makgobaKabinete e ikamanya le baagi ba boditšhabatšhaba mo go kgalemeng ka mafoko a a bogale ditiro tse di begilweng tse go tweng bana ba mmala wa sebilo ba ba fudugelang kwa dinageng tse dingwe ba tshwarwa jaaka makgoba fa ba goroga kwa nageng ya Libya.
tgt: Ku xavisiwa ka mahlonga ya vapfhumba va MaAfrikaKhabinete yi hlangana na vaaki va matiko ya misava ku yirisa ku xavisiwa ka vapfhumba va MaAfrika eLibya tanihi mahlonga.

src: Ditiro tsa mothale oo tse di senang botho di nyatsa ditumelano tsa AU le maano a mangwe a a mabapi a Aforika le a boditšhabatšhaba, go akaretsa Lekwalotshwanelo la Aforika le le ka ga Ditshwanelo tsa Botho le batho.
tgt: Swiendlo leswi pfumalaka vumunhu a swi fambelani na milawu ya AU, na milawu yin'wana ya Afrika na matiko ya misava, ku katsa Tsalwa ra Timfanelo ra Afrika eka Timfanelo ta Vanhu na Vumunhu.

src: Kabinete e amogetse tsiboso ya bothati ya gore ba tla tlhoma lefelo la go tsena le gotswa kwa Tripoli go ka thusa bafodugedi le batshamedi ba dinaga tse dingwe ba ba tlhokang go ka sirelediwa mo maemong a boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku tivisiwa ka valawuri lava nga ta vekiwa laha ku nghenaka na ku huma vanhu eTripoli eka vahlampfa na vapfhumba lava lavaka nsirhelelo wa matiko ya misava.

src: Go nama ga bolwetse jwa ListeriosisKabinete e ikuela mo bathong botlhe go tsaya dikgato tse di babalesegileng ka fao go tlhokagalang – tse di jaaka go tlhapa diatla pele ba ka baakanya dijo mme ba se je dijo tse di tala kgotsa tse di sa apeiwang – go ka fokotsa go anama ga bolwetse jwa Listeriosis, fa dipatlisiso di ntse di tsweletse go ka leka go bona gore motswedi wa twatsi eno o tswa o le mo kokwanatlhokong efe.
tgt: Ntungu wa ListeriosisKhabinete yi kombela vanhu hinkwavo ku endla leswi nga ringanela ku tisirhelela, ku fana na ku hlamba mavoko loko va nga si lulamisa swakudya na ku papalata swakudya swi mbisi kumbe leswi nga swekiwangiki, ku hunguta ku hangalaka ka listeriosis, loko vulavisisi bya ha ya emahlweni ku kuma laha xitsongwatsongwani xi humaka kona.

src: Bolwetse jono bo tsa mo kokwanatlhokong e e fitlhelwang mo mmung, mo metsing, mo dijalong le mo ditlhagisiweng tsa mašwi tse di sa apeiwang, mme e ka dira seka mokgotlhwane mo o ka iphitlhelang o tsholola.
tgt: Vuvabyi byi vangiwa hi xitsongwatsongwani lexi humaka emisaveni, ematini, eswimilannii na le ka switirhisiwa swa masi lama nga tengisiwangiki, naswona swi nga vanga matitwelo yo fana na ya mukhuhlwani lawa ya nga na nchuluko.

src: Yona e ka alafiwa ka melemo ya di antibiotic, fa e ka lemogiwa go sa le gale.
tgt: Byi nga tshunguriwa kahle hi ku tirhisa swidzidziharisi, loko swi kumiwa hi xihatla.

src: Kabinete e santse e ikuela mo baaging go sonaga metsi ka ntlha ya fa naga e tswelela go nna mo lešekereng.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela MaAfrika-Dzonga ku ya emahlweni na ku tirhisa mati kahle loko tiko ra ha ya emahlweni ri tokota dyandza.

src: Go sa kgathalesege dipula tse dintseng di tsweletse go tsorotla mo gautshwane, maemo a letamo naga ka bophara a tswelela go wela tlase.
tgt: Hi nga languti timpfula leti ta ha ku va kona, mipimo ya madamu ya tiko ya ya ehansi.

src: Seno ke ka ntlha ya mogote o o tsweletseng mmogo le gore ga re ise re itemogele go tsorotla ga dipula go go latelaneng go sa kgaotse.
tgt: Leswi swi vangiwa hi maxelo ya ku hisa kasi a hi se va na mpfula leyi tshamelaka ku na.

src: Kabinete e rotloetsegile tota ka dipuisano tse di nang le ditharabololo magareng ga dimasepala tse di tseneng ka tlhogo mo dikolotong gore go bonwe tharabololo ya go ka ntsha dimasepala tseno mo dikolotong tseo.
tgt: Khabinete ya hlohloteleka hi ku ya emahlweni ka mivulavurisano na timasipala leti nga na swikweleti swa le henhla ku kuma xintshuxo eka xikweleti xa masipala.

src: Melaotlhomo.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Kabinete e atlenegisitse go tlisiwa kwa Palamenteng ga Melaotlhomo e e latelang:.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Milawumbisi leyi landzelaka ePalamende.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Diphetogo tsa Thuso ya Loago wa 2017.Molaotlhomo ono o rebola dipoelo tse di tokafaditsweng tebang le madithuso a tlhokomelo ya bana ba dikhutsana le ba ba leng mo tlalelong, go akaretsa bao e leng bona ba ba tlhokometseng malapa a bobona.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa ku Cinca Mpfuno wa Vaaki wa 2017.Nawumbisi wu nyika mivuyelo leyi antswisiweke eka mudende wa vana lava nga swisiwana na vana lava nga sirheleriwangiki, ku katsa na volava va tshamaka emindyangwini leyi rhangeriweke hi vana.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Badiredi ba Dithoto wa 2017.Molaotlhomo ono o tsena mo legatong la Molao wa Merero ya Dithoto tsa Dieijente, 1976 (Molao wa bo 112 wa 1976).
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Vaxavisi va Tinhundzu wa 2017Nawumbisi wu herisa Nawu wa Timhaka ta Tiejensi to Xavisa Tindlu, wa 1976 (Nawu wa 112 wa 1976).

src: O tlhola tikologo e e kgontshang e e nang le melawana go ka rotloetsa ditiro tsa ikonomi ka intaseteri ya dithoto tsa dintlo fa mo letlhakoreng le lengwe e samagana le tlhokego ya go netefatsa fa go nna le phetolothefosano mo lekaleng leno.
tgt: Wu endla leswaku ku va mbangu wa vulawuri ku yisa emahlweni migingiriko ya ikhonomi eka vumaki bya ku xavisa tindlu loko ku karhi ku tiyisisiwa ku lulamisa ku tisa ku cinca eka sekithara.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Diphetogo tsa Letlhomeso la Makwalothuto a Bosetšhaba (NQF) wa 2016.Molaotlhomo ono o matlafatsa Molao o o leng teng ga jaanong wa NQF, 2008 (Molao wa bo 67 wa 2008).
tgt: Nawumbisi wa ku Ndzhundzhuluko wa Rimba ra Mathwaselo wa Rixaka wa 2016Nawumbisi wu tiyisisa Nawu wa Rimba ra Mathwaselo wa Rixaka lowu nga kona sweswi, 2008 (Nawu wa 67 wa 2008).

src: O tsenya tirisong dikgato tsa go samagana le merero ya go tlhoka tolamo mme e tlhagisa ditlamorago tse di tla lebanang mang le mang yo a ka tlamelang ka makwaloithuto a a sa lolamang kana ditheo tse di rebolang makwalothuto a a sa lolamang.
tgt: Wu yirisa tindlela ta ku tirhana na timhaka ta vuxisi na ku veka switandzhaku eka munhu loyi a endlaka vuxisi eka mathwaselo ya yena kumbe mihlangano leyi nyikaka minhwaso leyi nga ri ki yona.

src: Molaotlhomo wa Bosenyi jwa Boditšhabatšhaba wa 2017.Molaotlhomo ono o tlhagisitse letlhomeso la molao le le tokafaditsweng go samagana le bosenyi jwa boditšhabatšhaba jo bo dirilweng mo nageng ya Aforika Borwa le kwa ntle ga melelwane ya naga.
tgt: Nawumbisi wa Milandzu ya Matiko ya Misava wa 2017Nawumbisi wu nyika rimba ra nawu lowu antswisiweke ku tirhana na milandzu ya matiko ya misava leyi endliwaka laha Afrika-Dzonga na ku tlula ndzilekana.

src: Gape o tlhagisa tshireletsego le bosiamisi jo bo tokafaditsweng tebang le batswasetlhabelo ba bosenyi jwa boditšhabatšhaba.
tgt: Wu tlhela wu nyika ku antswa eka nsirhelelo na vululami eka vatwisiwakuvava va vugevenga bya matiko ya misava.

src: Melaetsa.
tgt: Mahungu.

src: Kabinete e akgotse:.
tgt: Khabinete yi bele mandla eka:.

src: Moporesitente Uhuru Kenyatta ka boikaniso jwa gagwe jaaka Moporesitente wa Rephaboliki ya Kenya le go nna lekgetlho la bobedi mo setulong sa gagwe mo pusong.
tgt: Phuresidente Uhuru Kenyatta eka ku vekiwa ka yena tanihi Phuresidente wa Rhiphabuliki ra Kenya na ku va eka theme ya vumbirhi ya mfumo.

src: Puso e ikaeletse go dira botsalano jo bo gagametseng jo bo tla itumedisang dinaga tsa rona ka bobedi.
tgt: Khabinete yi langutela ku ya emahlweni na ku aka vuxaka lebyi tiyeke lebyi matiko hayambirhi ya ti phinaka ha byona.

src: Moporesitente Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa ka boikaniso jwa gagwe jaaka Moporesitente wa Rephaboliki ya Zimbabwe.
tgt: Phuresidente Emmerson Dambudzo Mnangagwa eka ku vekiwa ka yena tanihi Phuresidente wa Rhiphabuliki ra Zimbabwe.

src: Kabinete e ikaeletse go tswelela go gagamatsa tirisano mmogo le puso ya Zimbabwe.
tgt: Khabinete yi langutela ku ya emahlweni ka vuxaka lebyi tiyeke na Mfumo wa Zimbabwe.

src: Majoro Seitebatso Pearl Block ka go fenya Dikabo tsa Ngwaga le Ngwaga tsa Dinagakopano (UN) ka ga Boeteledipeleng jwa Bong mo Sesoleng.
tgt: Mejara Seitebatso Pearl Block eka ku xiximiwa ka yena ku va a kuma Sagwadi ra Lembe ra Nhlangano wa Matiko ya Misava (UN) hi ku va a ri Gqweta ra Madzolonga ya ku ya hi Rimbewu eka Mavuthu.

src: Dikabo tseno di bontsha boineelo le matsapa a batho ka bong ba a dirang go ka nna batlisakagiso mo go tsholetseng dikgato tseno mo Molaong wa Lekgotla la Tshireletsego ya UN wa 1325, o o ikuelang mo maphateng otlhe a a lwantshanang go sireletsa basadi le basetsanyana kgatlhanong le Tshotlakako e e Totileng Batho ba Bong jo bo Rileng (GBV).
tgt: Sagwadi leri ri tekela enhlokweni ku tinyikela na matimba ya munhu loyi a tisaka ku rhula na ku seketela milawu eka Xintshuxo xa Huvo ya Vusirheleri ya UN ya 1324, leyi kombelaka mavandla hinkwawo lawa ya lwaka ku sirhelela vavasati na vanhwanyana eka mixaniso ya swa masangu na madzolonga ya ku ya hi rimbewu.

src: Setlhopha sa diopedi sa Ladysmith Black Mambazo, se se amogetseng ditlhopho di le pedi tsa Dikabo tsa Grammy tsa 2018.
tgt: Ladysmith Black Mambazo, lava va nga vayimelakulangwa va Masagwadi ya tiGrammy ya 2018.

src: Tlhopho ya ntlha e ka ga tlhopho ya Albamo ya Mmino e e Monate Lefatshe ka Bophara ka albamo ya bona ya Shaka Zulu Revisited: 30th Anniversary Celebration, mme tlhopho ya bobedi e ka ga Albamo e e Monate go Gaisa ya Bana mabapi le Dipina tsa Kagiso le Lerato tsa Bana le Batsadi go ralala Lefatshe ka Bophara.
tgt: Ko sungula ku le ka xiyenge xa Alibamu ya Vunanga bya Matiko ya Misava bya Kahle hi Alibamu ya vona ya Shaka Zulu Revisited: 30th Anniversary Celebation, ya vumbirhi yi le ka Alibamu ya Vana ya Khale eka Songs of Peace & Love for Kids & Parents around the World Masagwadi ya tiGrammy ya ta va kona hi ti 28 Sunguti 2018.

src: Chad Le Clos, ka go nna mofenyi wa ntlha wa monna wa mothumi go fenya lethathama la dikgele tsa Sejana sa Lefatshe sa Bathumi sa FINRe motlotlo ka phenyo ya gagwe mme e bile re na le tshepo ya gore o tla tswelela go emela naga ya Aforika Borwa ka manontlhotlho.
tgt: Chad Le Clos, ku va a vile muhlamberi wa xinuna wo sungula ku va a hlula hi ka mune eka Khapu ya Misava ya ku Hlambela ya FINA eka nongonoko wa swiyenge.

src: SuperSport United, ka go fitlha kwa makgaolakganyeng a Sejana sa Mokgatlho wa Metshameko ya Kgwele ya Dinao wa Aforika.
tgt: SuperSport United, ku va yi fikelerile ntlangu wo hetisela wa Confederation of African Football Confederetions Cup.

src: Mmabontle wa Aforika Borwa, Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ka go apesiwa korone ya Mmabontle wa Lefatshe ka Bophara kwa khonthesteng ya bo 66 e e neng e tshwerwe mo nakong e e sa tswang go feta kwa Amerika (USA).
tgt: N’wambhuri wa Afrika-Dzonga, Demi-Leigh Nel-Peters, ku va hlurile eka N'wambhuri wa Matiko ya Misava eka Van’wambhuri wa vu 66 lowu a wu khomeriwe eAmerika.

src: Ngaka Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, yo a abetsweng Kabo ya Diphitlhelelo mo Botshelong ke Foramo ya Lefatshe Lotlhe ya Baeteledipele mo Dipolotiking.
tgt: Dr Nkosazana Dlamini-Zuma, loyi a nga nyikiwa sagwadi ra Lifetime Achievement hi Foramu ya Misava ya Varhangeri va Vamanana va Tipolitiki.

src: Kabinete e romela matshediso a yona kwa:.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhumela marito yo chavelela eka:.

src: Pusong ya batho ba Egepeto go latela ditiragalo tsa borukhutlhi kwa kerekeng ya Sinai Peninsula mo go tlhokafetseng batho ba feta 300 le go gobatsa ba bangwe ba le bantsinyana.
tgt: Mfumo na vanhu va Egipta endzhaku ka mihlaselo ya vutherorisi eka yindlu yo khongela eSinai Peninsula leyi nga koxa vutomi bya vanhu va 300 na ku vavisa van'wanyana vo hlaya.

src: Kabinete e kgalema ka mafoko a a bogale ditlhaselo tseno tse di setlhogo mo bathong ba ba senang molato.
tgt: Khabinete yi alelana na mihlaselo leyi nga ri ki kahle eka vaaki lava pfumalaka nandzu.

src: Pusong le baagi ba Nigeria go latela moiphamphodi ka bomo o a iphampholotseng ka la bo 21 Ngwanaitseele 2017 moo batho ba le 50 ba tlhokafetseng mme ba bangwe ba le bantsinyana bona ba tswileng dikgobalo.
tgt: Mfumo na vanhu va Nigeria endzhaku ka munhu loyi a nga tidlaya hi bomo hi ti 21 Hukuri 2017 leyi nga dlaya vanhu va 50 na ku vavisa votala.

src: Kabinete e boeletsa boemo jwa yona le go kgalema ka mafoko a a bogale a a sa kateng ditiragalo tsa borukhutlhi le dintwa tse di setlhogo.
tgt: Khabinete yi tlhela yi vula nakambe milawu ya yona na ku nga tipfinyingi hi ku alelana na vutherorisi na madzolonga ya vupfumeri lebyi alelaka byin'wana.

src: Ba lelapa le ditsala tsa Ngaka Mochubela ‘Wesi’ Seekoe, mogale wa kgaratlhelokgololesego yo gape e leng Moambasatara wa mo Malobeng wa Aforika Borwa kwa Nageng ya Russia gape e le Monnasetulo wa Koporasi ya Motlakase wa Nyutlelia ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ndyangu na vanghana va Dok Mochubela 'Wesi" Seekoe, nhenha ya mulwela ntshuxeko na khale ka muyimeri wa Afrika-Dzonga eka Federexini ya Rhaxiya.

src: Moporesitente Zuma o ntshitse lefoko la gore a direlwe Phitlho ya Semmuso e e Itlhophileng ya porofense.
tgt: U tirhele tiko hi ndlela ya xiyimo xa le henhla tanihi Muyimeri wa Afrika-Dzonga eRhaxiya na ku va Mutshamaxitulu wa Nhlangano wa Eneji ya Nyutliliya ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Ba lelapa le ditsala tsa ga Mokgaratlhela tokologo wa mogale yo a neng a latlhetswe kwa kgolegelong ya Roben Island, Rre Eddie Daniels, yo mo nakong e e sa tswang go feta a latswitseng kika.
tgt: Ndyangu na vanghana va khale ka mukhotsiwa na Mulwelantshuxeko wa le Robben Island, Tatana Eddie Daniels, loyi a ha ku hundzaka emisaveni.

src: O tla gopolwa ka boineelo jwa gagwe le tirelo e a e neetseng batho ba Aforika Borwa.
tgt: U ta tsundzukiwa hi ku tinyikela ka yena na vukorhokeri eka vanhu va Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Ba lelapa le ditsala tsa ga Tona ya Sesole le Bagale ba Sesole, Mme Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, ka go tlhokafala ga rre wa gagwe, Rre Douglas Mapisa.
tgt: Ndyangu na vanghana va khale ka Holobye wa Vusirheleri na Mavuthu, Manana Nosiviwe Mapisa-Nqakula, eka ku hundza emisaveni ka tata wakwe, Tatana Douglas Mapisa.

src: O tlhokafaletse kwa Sepetleleng sa kwa East London sa Cecilia Makiwane, kwa Kapa Botlhaba a na le dingwaga di le 96.Ditiragalo tse di Tlang.
tgt: U hundzile emisaveni exibedlhele xa Cecilia Makiwane eEast London, eKapa-Vuxa a ri na malembe ya 96.Mitlangu leyi landzelaka.

src: Go keteka tlotlo ya ngwagakgolo ya ga Nelson MandelaKabinete e ikamanya le maAforika Borwa mo go ketekeng tlotlo ya ngwagakgolo wa bone wa ga Nelson Mandela fa e sale a tlhokafala ka la bo 5 Sedimonthole 2013.
tgt: Malembe xidzana ya ku tsundzuka Nelson MandelaKhabinete yi hlangana na MaAfrika-Dzonga eka ku tsundzuka malembe ya mune ya ku hundza emisaveni ka khale ka Nelson Mandela hi ti 5 N'wendzamhala 2013.

src: Ka 2018 naga e tla keteka tlotlo ya ngwagakgolo ya botshelo jwa ga Mandela mme maAforika Borwa otlhe a rotloediwa go ikamanya le mekete eno ya ngwaga otlhe go bontsha tlotlo go yo mongwe wa basimane ba ba golo ba Aforika.
tgt: Hi 2018 tiko ri ta fungha malembexidzana ya vutomi bya Mandela laha MaAfrika-Dzonga ya hlohloteriwaka ku nghenela ntlangelo wa lembe hinkwaro loko ha ha tsundzuka un'wana wa vana va Afrika lonkulu.

src: Kabinete e leboga maAforika Borwa otlhe ka go tsaya karolo mo meketeng ya tlotlo e e farologaneng ya ga OR Tambo e e neng e tshwerwe go ralala le naga mme e solofela go tla nna fela jalo ka re tla bo re gopola mogaka wa rona yo gape e leng Moporesitente wa Aforika Borwa wa ntlha yo a tlhophilweng ka mokgwa wa temokerasi, Madiba.
tgt: Khabinete yi khensa MaAfrika-Dzonga ku va va nghenelerile eka ku tsundzuka ko hambanahambana ka mitlangu laha tikweni ka OR Tambo na ku tlhela hi langutela ku nghenelela ko tani loko ha ha tsundzuka nhenha ya hina na Phuresidente wo sungula loyi a nga hlawuriwa wa xidemokirasi, Madiba.

src: Paka ya khunologoKabinete e lakaletsa maAforika Borwa otlhe khunologo e e segofetseng e bile e rena kagiso.
tgt: Nguva ya KhisimusiKabinete yi navelela MaAfrika-Dzonga nkarhi wa ntsako na nguva ya khisimusi ya vuhlayiseki.

src: Re ikuela mo go bao ba tla bong ba tsaya maeto go netefatsa gore dijanaga tsa bona di baakanyeditswe maeto a matelele ao.
tgt: Hi kombela lava nga ta va va ri emagondzweni ku tiyisisa leswaku swifambo swa vona swi ringanerile ku va emagondzweni.

src: Badirisi botlhe ba mebila, bakganni ba dijanaga le batsamayakadinao ba tshwanetse go obamela melao ya tsela.
tgt: Vatirhisi va magondzo, vachayeri na vafambi hi milenge va fanele ku landzelela milawu ya le magondzweni.

src: Tona ya Lefapha la Dipalangwa, Rre Joe Maswanganyi, o thankgolotse letsholo la Arrive Alive kwa Bela-Bela, Limpopo ka la bo 5 Sedimonthole.
tgt: Holobye wa Vutleketli, Tatana Joe Maswanganyi u simekile pfhumba ra Arrive Alive eBela-Bela, eLimpopo hi ti 5 N'wendzamhala.

src: Tirelo ya Sepodisi sa Aforika Borwa (SAPS) e tsenya tirisong letsholo la yona naga ka bophara la paka ya khunologo e e babalesegileng mme botlhe ba na le maikarabelo a go tshegetsa SAPS ka go tlotla molao le go nna le maikarabelo.
tgt: SAPS yi simeka pfhumba ra tiko hinkwaro ku va na nguva ya khisimusi yo hlayiseka na ku va na vutihlamuleri ku seketela SAPS hi ku landzelela nawu na matikhomelo lamanene.

src: Lefapha la Merero ya Selegae le tla rebola maano a paka ya khunologo a 2017/18 mabapi le tikologo ya melelwane ya Aforika Borwa.
tgt: Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Xikaya yi ta tivisa hi makungu ya 2017/18 ya mikarhi ya makhisimusi ya Afrika-Dzonga eka timhaka ta le mindzilekanini.

src: Seno se mabapi le tsamaiso e e lolameng ya go kgabaganya ga batho le dithoto go tswa le go tsena mo Aforika Borwa mo pakeng ya fa go tla bo go iwa kwa godimo le kwa WEBTOKEN ikuela gape le mo batsading go se tlhokomologe bana ba bona ka e le maikarabelo a rona go tlhokomela bana ba rona.
tgt: Leswi i swa ku fambisa hi ku olova na mafambiselo ya kahle ya vanhu na tinhundzu ku nghena na ku huma laha Afrika-Dzonga hi nkarhi lowu wa mphesamphesa.

src: Kabinete e itumedisitswe ke ditlhatlhobo tsa Materiki tse di tsweletseng ntle le dikgoreletso tse dintsi mme e lakaletsa barutwana ba 2017 masego ka ba tla bo ba letetse dipholo tsa bona tsa bofelo.
tgt: Hi tlhela hi kombela vatswari na vahlayisi ku va va nga tshiki vana va nga ri na vulanguteri tanihilaha hi nga hi bohekaka ku va hlayisa.

src: Go thapiwaGo thapiwa gotlhe go tla diragadiwa fa makwalothuto otlhe a netefaditswe mme go amogetswe tetlelelo e e matshwanedi.
tgt: Ku thoriwaKu thoriwa hinkwako ku ya hi ku tiyisisiwa ka mithwaso na ku basisiwa loku faneleke.

src: Mme Ilise Karg jaaka moemedi wa dti mo Lekgotleng la Dikeletso ka Boitshimololedi la Bosetšhaba.
tgt: Manana Ilise Karg tanihi muyimeri wa dti eka Huvo ya Vutsundzuxi ya Rixaka eka Vundlandlamuxi.

src: Rre Sandile Mkhize, jaaka Mokaedikhuduthamagamogolo (CEO) wa Magalies Water.
tgt: Tatana Phakamani Buthelezi, tanihi CEO wa Overberg Water.

src: Rre Wiseman Mkhize, jaaka leloko la Boto ya Bolaodi jwa Motlakase wa Naga jwa Aforika Borwa (NERSA).
tgt: Advocate Samuel Vukela, tanihi Mulawuri-Angarhelo wa Ndzawulo ya Mitirho.

src: Rre Phakamani Buthelezi, jaaka CEO wa Overberg Water.
tgt: Manana Brenda Sibeko, tanihi Xandla xa DG (DDG) eka Vusirheleri byo Angarhela eka Vaaki eka Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Vaaki.

src: Moatefokate Samuel Vukela, jaaka Mokaedikakaretso (DG) wa Lefapha la Ditiro tsa Puso.
tgt: Tatana Zephania Nhleko, tanihi DDG wa Makunguhatelo ya Ikhonomi na Vuhlanganisi eka Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Ikhonomi.

src: Mme Brenda Sibeko, jaaka Motlatsamokaedikakaretso (DDG) mabapi le Tshireletsego ya Loago e e Feletseng mo Lefapheng la Tlhabololo ya Loago.
tgt: Tatana Mandla Victor Ngcobo, tanihi DDG: Murhangerinkulu wa Vuxokoxoko wa Mfumo eka DPSA.

src: Cabinet met on Wednesday, 28 February 2018, at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlangane hi Ravunharhu, 28 Nyenyanyana 2018, eTuynhuys, Kapa.

src: National Budget Speech.
tgt: Mbulavulo wa Mpimanyeto wa Rixaka.

src: Cabinet appreciates the overwhelming confidence expressed in the 2018 National Budget which was tabled in Parliament, Cape Town, last week.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ntshembo lowukulu lowu paluxiweke eka Mpimanyeto wa Rixaka wa 2018 lowu andlariweke ePalamende, Kapa, vhiki leri nga hundza.

src: In the recent spirit of renewal that has gripped our great nation, Cabinet calls on all South Africans to partner with government to grow our economy and create much-needed jobs.
tgt: Eka moya lowu wa ha ku va ka kona wa mpfuxelelo lowu khomeke tiko ra ka hina lero saseka, Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku tirhisana na mfumo ku kurisa ikhonomi ya hina na ku tumbuluxa mitirho leyi dingiwaka swonghasi.

src: The reduction in expenditure of R85 billion over the next three years demonstrates government’s commitment to fiscal consolidation and the prudent allocation of resources to grow the economy.
tgt: Ku hunguteka eka ntirhiso wa timali ta R85 wa tibiliyoni eka malembe manharhu lama taka ku kombisa vutiyimiseri bya mfumo ku hlanganisa swa timali na avelo wa vurhon’wana wa switirhisiwa ku kurisa ikhonomi.

src: The steps announced to slow the pace of debt accumulation and contain the budget deficit greatly improve our fiscal framework and give South Africans confidence in the future prospects of our economy.
tgt: Magoza ya tivisiwile ku hunguta rivilo ra mpfelelo wa xikweleti na ku lawula nkayivelo wa mpimanyeto swinene ku antswisa rimba ra swa timali ta hina na ku nyika MaAfrika-Dzonga ntshembo eka leswi nga humelelaka mikarhi leyi taka swa ikhonomi ya hina.

src: Cabinet is resolute that the interventions will reflect in our country’s economic growth, affirm its economic standing and safeguard its investment grade status.
tgt: Khabinete ya tiboha leswaku miphalalo yi ta kombeta eka ku kula ka ikhonomi ya tiko ra ka hina, yi tiyisisa xiyimo xa rona xa timali na ku sirhelela xiyimo xa rona xa giredi ya vuvekisi.

src: The 2018 National Budget supports the poor in our society through a comprehensive social assistance programme and fee-free tertiary education for students from poor households.
tgt: Mpimanyeto wa Rixaka wa 2018 wu seketela lava sweleke erixakeni ra hina hi ku tirhisa pfhumba ra mpfuneto wa vaaki na dyondzo ya le henhla ya mahala eka swichudeni leswi humaka emitini leyi sweleke.

src: As a response to the concern raised on the Value-Added Tax (VAT) increases proposed, Cabinet is considering expanding the list of basic goods that are zero-rated on VANelson Mandela Centenary.
tgt: Tanihi angulo eka ku khumbeka loku boxiweke eka miengetelo ya Xibalo xa Mixavo (VAT), Khabinete yi le ku langutisiseni ka ku ndlandlamuxa nxaxamelo wa tinhundzu ta masungulo leti nga hakerisiwiki xibalo.

src: Cabinet joins President Cyril Ramaphosa in his call on South Africans to reaffirm a shared commitment to serve people as we continue to celebrate the centenary of the birth of former President Nelson Mandela.
tgt: Khabinete yi tikatsa na Phuresidente Cyril Ramaphosa eka xirhambo xa yena xa MaAfrika-Dzonga ku tiyisisa hi vuntshwa ku tiboha ka yona ka nhlanganelo ku korhokela vanhu tanihiloko hi ya emahlweni hi tlangela malembexidzana ya ku velekiwa ka khale ka Phuresidente Nelson Mandela.

src: Madiba is the first President of a Democratic South Africa and would have turned 100 years of age on 18 July 2018.
tgt: Madiba i Phuresidente wo sungula wa Afrika-Dzonga ya xidemokirasi naswona a ta va a ri na 100 wa malembe hi vukhale hi siku ra 18 Mawuwani 2018.

src: Madiba is a global icon who is revered worldwide as a Champion of Human Rights, non-racism and non-sexism.
tgt: Madiba i mfungho wa misava loyi a xiximiwaka misava hinkwayo tanihi Nghwazi ya Timfanelo ta Ximunhu, loyi a nga yiki hi nghohe na ku va loyi a nga yiki hi rimbewu.

src: He played a critical role in unifying South Africans, and inspiring democratic unity across Africa and the globe.
tgt: U tirhile ntirho wa nkoka swonghasi eka ku hlanganisa MaAfrika-Dzonga, na ku hlohlotela vun’we bya xidemokirasi eAfrika hinkwaro na le misaveni hinkwayo.

src: The first celebration of Nelson Mandela’s centenary took place during the African Union Summit in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia in January 2018.
tgt: Ku tlangeriwa ko sungula ka malembexidzana ya Nelson Mandela ku vile kona hi nkarhi wa Samiti ya Nhlangano wa Afrika eAddis Ababa, Ethiopia hi Sunguti 2018.

src: A number of events will be held throughout the country this year to reflect on the life of Tata Madiba.
tgt: Swiendleko swo tala swi ta endliwa etikweni hinkwaro nan’waka ku ehleketa hi vutomi bya Tatana Madiba.

src: Cabinet calls upon all South Africans to join in the centenary celebrations in their workplaces, schools, churches and civic organisations.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba MaAfrika-Dzonga hinkwawo ku tikatsa eka mitlangelo ya malembexidzana emitirhweni, eswikolweni, etikerekeni na le ka mihlangano ya vaaki ya vona.

src: It calls on each one of us this year to emulate the values of Nelson Mandela by working in our respective ways to build a united, non-racist, non-sexist and prosperous country.
tgt: Yi rhamba munhu un’wana na un’wana wa hina nan’waka ku encenyeta mikhuvanene ya Nelson Mandela hi ku tirha hi tindlela ta hina ku aka tiko leri nga na vun’we, leri nga yiki hi nghohe, leri nga yiki hi rimbewu na ku va leri humelelaka.

src: The country also celebrates the centenary of one of the great daughters of the African soil Mama Albertina Sisulu, who dedicated her life to fight for the emancipation of women and the liberation of South Africa.
tgt: Nakambe tiko ri tlangela malembexidzana ya yin’wana ya tintombi ta kahle ta tiko ra Afrika Manana Albertina Sisulu, loyi a nyiketeke vutomi bya yena ku lwela ntshunxeko wa vavasati na ntshunxeko wa Afrika-Dzonga.

src: Cabinet will in the next meeting also outline a programme for the celebration of the Centenary of Mama Albertina Sisulu.
tgt: Khabinete eka nhlengeletano leyi landzelaka yi ta tlhela yi hlamusela nongonoko wa ku tlangela Malembexidzana ya Manana Albertina Sisulu.

src: Drought.
tgt: Dyandza.

src: Cabinet appreciates the relentless efforts made by the Inter-Ministerial Committee on Drought together with stakeholders in all spheres of government and society in dealing with the persistent drought conditions that have hit several parts of the country.
tgt: Khabinete yi khensa matshalatshala lama nga heriki ntamu lama endliweke hi Komiti ya le Xikarhi ka Vaholobye eka Dyandza swin’we na vakhomaxiave eka swiyenge hinkwaswo swa mfumo na rixaka eka ku tirhana na swiyimo swa dyandza leswi phikelelaka leswi hlaseleke swiphemu swi nga ri swingani swa tiko.

src: Apart from the fact that South Africa is a water-scarce country, the effects of global warming continue to affect the rain patterns, thus causing our dam levels to remain low.
tgt: Handle ka ntiyiso wa leswaku Afrika-Dzonga i tiko leri nga na vukali bya mati, switandzhaku swa nkufumelo wa xibakabaka swi ya emahlweni swi khumba manelo ya mpfula, hikwalaho ka sweswo swi vanga mipimo ya madamu ya hina ku tshama yi ri ehansi.

src: The Inter-Ministerial Task Team on Drought continues to facilitate work between national government, provinces and municipalities in all drought-affected areas.
tgt: Xipano xa Ntirho wa le Xikarhi ka Vaholobye eka Dyandza xi ya emahlweni xi humelerisa ntirho exikarhi ka mfumo wa rixaka, swifundzakulu na timasipala eka tindhawu leti khumbekeke hi dyandza hinkwato.

src: This includes implementing short, medium and long-term measures to address and mitigate the potential impact of this drought.
tgt: Leswi swi katsa ku simeka magoza ya nkarhinyana, ya nkarhi wa le xikarhi na wo leha ku lulamisa na ku hunguta ntshikelelo lowu nga vaka kona wa dyandza leri.

src: Government has made funds available to provide short-term assistance to affected provinces.
tgt: Mfumo wu endlile leswaku timali ti kumeka ku nyika mpfuneto wa nkarhinyana eka swifundzakulu leswi khumbekeke.

src: It has provided a relief grant worth R473 million and an additional R6 billion in the 2018/19 financial year to augment water infrastructure in the Western Cape‚ Eastern Cape and Northern Cape.
tgt: Wu nyikile mali ya nhlayiso wo phalala leyi nga na nkoka wa R473 wa timiliyoni na R6 wa tibiliyoni eka lembeximali ra 2018/19 ku engetela swimakiwakulu swa mati eKapa-Vupeladyambu, Kapa-Vuhumadyambu na Kapa-N’walungu.

src: Cabinet calls on all to continue to work with government in conserving water by using it responsibly and sparingly.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba hinkwerhu ku ya emahlweni hi tirhisana na mfumo eka ku hlayisa mati hi ku ya tirhisa hi ndlela ya vutihlamuleri naswona hi matsananatsanana.

src: Cabinet remains committed to making South Africa a country of choice for visitors and potential investors alike.
tgt: Khabinete yi tama ya ha tibohile ku endla Afrika-Dzonga tiko leri nga hlawuriwaka hi vayeni naswona swi tano eka vavekisi lava nga tshukaka va va kona.

src: Police killings.
tgt: Ku dlayeteriwa ka maphorisa.

src: Cabinet expresses condolences to the families and friends of the five police officers and a former soldier who were recently brutally murdered in an attack on the Ngcobo Police Station in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Khabinete yi yisa michavelelo eka mindyangu na vanghana va ntlhanu wa maphorisa na khale ka socha lava va ha ku dlayiwaka hi ndlela ya tihanyi eka nhlaselo wa le Xitichini xa Maphorisa xa Ngcobo eKapa-Vuhumadyambu.

src: Cabinet strongly condemns any senseless killing of our servicemen and women.
tgt: Khabinete yi sola swinene ku dlayeteriwa ku ri hava xivangelo ka vavanuna na vavasati lava hi korhokelaka.

src: The loss of one police officer, soldier or any other person who serves to protect society and our people is unacceptable.
tgt: Ku lahlekeriwa hi phorisa rin’we, socha kumbe munhu wihi kumbe wihi un’wana loyi a tirhaka ku sirhelela rixaka na vanhu va hina a swi amukeleki.

src: Cabinet has committed, through the Minister of Police, to do whatever possible to capacitate our police stations to prevent such attacks in the future.
tgt: Khabinete yi tibohile, hi ku tirhisana na Holobye wa Maphorisa, ku endla xihi kumbe xihi lexi nga kotekaka ku antswisa switichi swa hina swa maphorisa ku sivela mihlaselo yo tano emikarhini leyi taka.

src: Cabinet further appeals to parents and society at large to ensure children are kept safe at all times and to partner with law-enforcement agencies to protect the rights of our children.
tgt: Khabinete yi kombela ku ya emahlweni eka vatswari na rixaka hi ku angarhela ku tiyisisa leswaku vana va hlayisiwa hi mikarhi hinkwayo na ku tirhisana na vayimeri vo sindzisa nawu ku sirhelela timfanelo ta vana.

src: Any form of abuse against a child must be exposed and reported immediately.
tgt: Muxaka wihi kumbe wihi wa nxaniso ehenhla ka n’wana wu fanele ku humeseriwa erivaleni na ku mangariwa xikan’wekan’we.

src: By working together, we can keep our communities safe and ensure that criminal elements have no place to hide.
tgt: Hi ku tirhisana, hi nga endla miganga ya ka hina yi tshama yi hlayisekile na ku tiyisisa leswaku vanhu lava endlaka vugevenga va pfumala vutumbelo.

src: Cabinet decisions Cabinet approved the Draft Revised White Paper on National Transport Policy to be published for public comments.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Mpfapfarhuto wa Tirhele leri Pfuxetiweke eka Pholisi Vutleketli ya Rixaka ku va wu kandziyisiwa ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: The policy aims to provide a transport system that is integrated with other related sector plans so as to reduce both the cost of commuting and doing business.
tgt: Pholisi yi na xikongomelo xa ku nyika sisiteme ya vutleketli leyi hlanganisiweke na makungu ya tisekitara tin’wana leti fambelanaka ku hunguta havumbirhi bya madurhelo ya ku khandziya xifambo ku ya entirhweni na ku endla bindzu.

src: It also aligns the country’s transportation plans to the global transportation trends.
tgt: Nakambe yi yelanisa makungu ya vutleketli ya tiko eka mitolovelo ya vutleketli bya misava.

src: Cabinet approved the Green Paper on Roads Policy for South Africa to be published for public comments.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Mpfampfarhuto wo Sungula eka Pholisi ya Magondzo ya Afrika-Dzonga ku va wu kandziyisiwa ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: The policy provides the overarching framework that ensures South Africa’s roads are better managed, safer and include all modes of transport to deliver a sustainable approach to roads management.
tgt: Pholisi leyi yi ta nyika rimba ro angarhela leri ri endlaka leswaku magondzo ya Afrika-Dzonga ya lawuriwa ku antswa, ya va ya hlayisekile swinene na ku katsa tinxaka hinkwayo ta vutleketli ku humelerisa endlelo leri yisekaka emahlweni ra malawulelo ya magondzo.

src: It guides the road regulations, infrastructure, safety, road funding and non- motorised transport.
tgt: Wu lawula swinawana swa le magondzweni, switirhisiwa, vuhlayiseki, ku nyikiwa ka timali ta magondzo na vutleketli lebyi nga fambiki hi njhini.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the 2015/16 National Survey of Research and Experimental Development (R&D Survey).R&D is an integral part of the country’s socio-economic development.
tgt: Khabinete yi nyikiwile vuxokoxoko hi mikumo ya Mbalango wa Rixaka wa Nhluvukiso wa Nkambisiso na Ndzavisiso (Mbalango wa R&D) wa 2015/16.

src: This has been collective efforts of government, industry and research institutions.
tgt: Lawa ya vile matshalatshala ya nhlanganelo ya mfumo, vumaki na mihlangano ya ndzavisiso.

src: The report is available on the Department of Science and Technology (DST) website: WEBTOKECabinet approved the designs of the 2018 commemorative collector’s coin series, which will be produced by the South African Mint Company.
tgt: Xiviko lexi xa kumeka eka webusayiti ya Ndzawulo ya Sayense na Thekinoloji (DST): WEBTOKEKhabinete yi pasisile tidizayini ta ntlhandlamano wa swingwece swa muhlengeleti swo tsundzuka wa 2018, lowu nga ta humesiwa hi Khamphani ya Mint ya Afrika-Dzonga.

src: The 2018 designs collection will be celebrating the Nelson Mandela Centenary.
tgt: Nhlengeleto wa tidizayini ta 2018 wu ta va ku tlangela Malembexidzana ya Nelson Mandela.

src: These collections were preceded by the 2017 commemorative coins that celebrated South Africa under the theme of Freedom, Democracy and Cultures.
tgt: Mihlengeleto leyi yi rhangeriwile hi swingwece swo tsundzuka swa 2017 leswi tlangeleke Afrika-Dzonga ehansi ka nkongomelo wa Ntshunxeko, Xidemokirasi na Mifuwo.

src: Bills.
tgt: Milawumbisi.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the Customary Initiation Bill of 2018 to Parliament.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Nawumbisi wa Ngoma ya Xintu wa 2018 ePalamende.

src: The Bill seeks to protect, promote and regulate the governance aspect of the practice of customary WEBTOKEN provides national norms and standards aimed at the protection of life and the prevention of injuries and all forms of abuse experienced by initiates.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu lava ku sirhelela, ku kondletela na ku lawula xiphemu xa mafumelo ya endlelo ra ngoma ya xintu.

src: The Bill, which amends the National Qualifications Framework Act, 2008 (Act 67 of 2008), strengthens the Act by improving measures to deal with issues of misrepresentation, imposes consequences on persons who misrepresent their qualifications or organisations that issue invalid WEBTOKEN also proposes regulations to ensure that fraudulent qualifications are referred to the relevant professional bodies (database of individuals who misrepresented their qualifications).
tgt: Wu nyika maendlelo na mipimo ya rixaka leyi nga na xikongomelo xa nsirhelelo wa vutomi na nsivelo wa timbanga na tindlela hinkwato ta nxaniso lowu vakwerha va hlanganaka na wona.

src: Cabinet approved the Railway Safety Bill of 2017 to be published for public comments.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile ku rhumeriwa ka Nawumbisi-ndzhundzhuluxo wa Rimba ra Mithwaso ya Rixaka wa 2016 ePalamende.

src: The Bill seeks to improve railway safety and create a governance structure to oversee the work of the Rail Safety Regulator of South Africa.
tgt: Nawumbisi lowu wu hundzuluxa Nawu wa Rimba ra Mithwaso wa Rixaka, 2008 (Nawu wa 67 wa 2008), wu tiyisa Nawu hi ku antswisa magoza ya ku tirhana na swiphiqo swa vunwa, wu rhwexa switandzhaku eka vanhu lava va nyikaka mithwaso ya vona ya vuxisi kumbe mihlangano leyi yi nyikaka mithwaso leyi nga riki enawini.

src: It is also aligned to the National Rail Policy regarding the strengthening of safety monitoring, and the promotion and enforcement of safety in our railways.
tgt: Nakambe wu ringanyeta swinawana swa ku tiyisisa leswaku mithwaso ya vuxisi yi kongomisiwa eka tihuvo ta xiphurofexinali leti faneleke (nhlayisa-switiviwa ya vanhu lava va nyikeke mithwaso ya vona ya vuxisi).

src: Cabinet approved for the Draft Economic Regulation of Transport Bill of 2017 to be published for public comments and consultation.
tgt: Nakambe wu lulamisa ku nyikiwa ka vululameri bya mithwaso ya matiko mambe.

src: The Bill addresses the regulatory and capacity gaps in respect of provision of a cost-effective and efficient transport system.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisi wa Vuhlayiseki bya le Swiporweni wa 2017 ku va wu kandziyisiwa ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki.

src: The theme of the conference is: “Horizon decent work: Advancing connectivity, coherence and inclusivity”.
tgt: Nakambe wu yelanisiwe na Pholisi ya Swiporo ya Rixaka hi mayelana na ku tiyisiwa ka vuvekatihlo bya vuhlayiseki, na ntlakuso na nsindziso wa vuhlayiseki eswiporweni swa hina.

src: Participants will include social partners – organised business, labour and community.
tgt: Khabinete yi pasisile Nawumbisimpfapfarhutwa wa Vulawuri bya Ikhonomi ya Vutleketli wa 2017 ku va wu kandziyisiwa ku kuma mavonelo ya vaaki na ku tihlanganisa na vaaki.

src: President Ramaphosa in his capacity as the Chair of SADC will undertake consultative visits to Angola, Botswana and Namibia from 2 to 3 March 2018.
tgt: Nawumbisi wu lulamisa mavangwa yo lawula na ya vuswikoti hi mayelana na ku nyikiwa ka sisiteme ya vutleketli leyi nga na nxavo lowu pfunaka na ku va wa vuswikoti.

src: South Africa will co-host the 17th World Conference on Tobacco or Health (WCTOH) from 7 to 9 March 2018 in Cape Town under the theme: “Uniting the World for a Tobacco-free Generation”.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga ri ta va ri rhurhela Vaholobye va Mitirho va Miganga ya Nhluvukiso ya le Dzongeni wa Afrika, Vuthori na Nsirhelelo wa Vanhu, tanihi Mutshamaxitulu, kusuka 1 kufika 2 Nyenyankulu 2018 eCape Town International Convention Centre.

src: The WTCOH calls for committed action and provides a platform for governments, civil-society organisations, United Nations agencies, international organisations, health workers and other stakeholders to discuss shared knowledge and experiences, particularly regarding to youth and women who are exposed to tobacco WEBTOKEN the conference contributes towards addressing the National Development Plan’s goals by creating awareness and education on the harmful effects of tobacco use, and the need to intensify tobacco control measures.
tgt: U ta heleketiwa hi Holobye wa Vuxaka bya Matiko ya Misava na Ntirhisano Lindiwe Sisulu na Holobye wa Vusirheleri na Khale ka Masocha Nosiviwe Maphisa Nqakula.

src: On the 10 and 11 March the IEC will open the Voting Registration Centres for people to come and register and check their registration details.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi rhurhela hi ku tirhisana Khomferense ya Misava ya vu17 eka Fole kumbe Rihanyu (WTCOH) kusuka 7 kufika 9 Nyenyankulu 2018 eKapa ehansi ka nkongomelo: “Ku Hlanganisa Misava eka Rixaka ro Pfumala Fole”.

src: The voting stations will be open between 08:00 and 17:00 to assist new voters to register to vote, and allow registered voters who have relocated to reregister in their correct voting district and update their address details on the voters’ roll.
tgt: Hi ti 10 na 11 Nyenyankulu IEC yi ta pfula Tisenthara ta Ntsariso wo Vhota leswaku vanhu va ta va ta tsarisa na ku kamba vuxokoxoko bya vona bya ntsariso.

src: Cabinet conveys its condolences to Deputy Minister Obed Bapela on the loss of his wife Constance Bapela, who served the country as a councillor at the time of her passing.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba ngopfungopfu vavhoti vo sungula ku tiyisisa leswaku va teka xiave eka mfanelo ya vona ya xidemokirasi xa vumbiwa ya ku vhota hi ku ya va ya tsarisela ku vhota.

src: Cabinet joins President Ramaphosa in conveying condolences to the family, friends and associates of the political economist and author, Prof Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, who passed on at the age of Cabinet congratulates Minister Naledi Pandor on her recognition by Leiden University in the Netherlands as an Oort Honorary Visiting Professor of Astronomy and Development.
tgt: Mahelo lama ya vhiki ra ntsariso ya ta va xiendleko xa nkoka lexi nga ta hetelela eka phurojeke ya malembe mambirhi ya ku kuma tikherefu ta vutshamo ta vavhoti hinkwavo lava tsariseke.

src: This is in recognition of the Minister’s extraordinary accomplishment in harnessing science, particularly astronomy, as a tool for global development and societal benefit.
tgt: Switichi swo vhotela swi ta pfula exikarhi ka 08:00 na 17:00 ku pfuna vavhoti lavantshwa ku titsarisela ku vhota, na ku pfumelela vavhoti lava tsariseke lava va rhurheleke kun’wana ku tsarisa hi vuntshwa eka xifundza xo vhotela lexi lulameke na ku pfuxeta vuxokoxoko bya vona bya tikherefu lebyi nga eka nxaxamelo wa vavhoti.

src: Mr Joseph Tebogo Leshope as Chief Operations Officer of SENTECMs Vuyo Zitumane as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Amatola Water.
tgt: Masagwadi lama a ya tekela enhlokweni ku dyondzisa na vurhangeri bya xiyimo xa le henhla eka mikhetekanyo yi nga ri yingani, ku katsa na Sagwadi ra Mfikelelo wa Vutomi Hinkwabyo ra Nelson Mandela na Sagwadi ra Phurofesa Kader Asmal.

src: Adv Seeng Catherine Ntsaba-Letele as Chief Ombud of the Community Schemes Ombud Service.
tgt: Khabinete yi hundzise michavelelo ya yona eka Xandla xa Holobye Obed Bapela eka ku lahlekeriwa hi nghamu yakwe Constance Bapela, loyi a tirha tanihi mukhanselara hi nkarhi wa ku hundza ka yena.

src: Mr Edward Mamadise as CEO of the National Regulator for Compulsory Specifications.
tgt: Khabinete yi tikatsa na Phuresidente Ramaphosa eka ku hundzisa michavelelo eka ndyangu, vanghana na vanakulobye va mutivinkulu wa ikhonomi ya swa tipolitiki tlhelo mutsari, Phurof Johannes “Sampie” Terreblanche, loyi a hundzeke emisaveni a ri na malembe ya 84 hi vukhale.

src: Dr Sagren Moodley as the representative from the DST on the South African Council for Natural Scientific Professions.
tgt: Khabinete yi hoyozela Holobye Naledi Pandor eka ku tekeriwa enhlokweni ka yena hi Yunivhesiti ya Leiden eNetherlands tanihi Xirho xo Xiximiwa xa Phurofesa yo Endzela ya Ntivotinyeleti na Nhluvukiso.

src: Reappointments to the Patent Examination Board:a. Ms Shanaaz Tiry Mahomedb.
tgt: Leswi i ku tekeriwa enhlokweni ka mifikelelo loku nga tolovelekangiki ka Holobye eka ku endla leswaku sayense yi tirhiseka ku humesa eneji, ngopfungopfu, ntivotinyeleti, tanihi xitirho xa nhluvukiso wa misava na mbuyelo wa rixaka.

src: Kabinete e tshwaretse kopano kwa Tuynhuis, Motse Kapa ka Laboraro, 14 Mopitlwe 2018Merero ya ga jaanong.
tgt: Khabinete yi hlanganile hi Ravunharhu, 14 Nyenyankulu 2018, eTuynhuys, eKapaXiyimo xa Khabinete eka Timhakankulu.

src: Kgolo ya Ikonomi.
tgt: Ku kula ka ikhonomi.

src: Kabinete e amogela kgolo ya ikonomi ka 1.3% ka 2017.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela 1.3% ya ku kula ka ikhonomi hi 2017.

src: Eno ke koketsego go tswa go 0.3% ka 2016.
tgt: Loku i ku tlakuka kusuka eka 0.3% hi 2016.

src: Tiragatso ya ikonomi ka fa tlase ga maemo a a boima e bonelapele ikonomi ya isago e e solofetsang ya naga.
tgt: Matirhelo ya ikhonomi ehansi ka swiyimo leswo tika ya tshembisa leswinene eka mikoteko ya nkarhi lowu taka ya tiko.

src: Dipalopalo tsa kgolo di bontsha gore ikonomi e a tlhatlhoga, le Matlotlo a Bosetšhaba a solofetse ikonomi go gola ka 1.5% monongwaga le go oketsega go ya go 2.1% ka 2020.
tgt: Tinhlayo ta ku kula ti komba leswaku ikhonomi yi le ka mafambelo lama yaka ehenhla, laha Nkwama wa Timali wa Rixaka wu langutelaka ikhonomi ku ndlandlamuka hi 1.5% nyan’waka na ku engetela kufika eka 2.1% hi 2020.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go maphata otlhe a setšhaba go agelela mo tswelopele e ntle ya 2017, le go dira mmogo le puso go fetolela maano a yona go nna tiragatso ya mmatota go tsweledisa kgolo ya ikonomi le go tlhola ditiro.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba tisekithara hinkwato ta rixaka ku aka ehenhla ka nkhinkhi lowunene wa 2017, na ku tirhisana na mfumo ku hundzuluxela makungu ya wona ya va xiendlo xo khomeka ku hlayisa ku kula ka ikhonomi na ku tumbuluxa mitirho.

src: Ntšhwafatso ya Mafatshe Kabinete e amogela tshitshinyo ya go fetola Molaotheo wa Aforika Borwa wa 1996 gore o tle o letle go tsewa ga lefatshe ntle le tuelo.
tgt: Mpfuxeto wa Misava Khabinete yi amukela kungu leri amukeriweke ku hundzuluxa Vumbiwa ra Rhiphabuliki ya Afrika-Dzonga ra 1996 ku endlela ku pfumelela ku tlherisiwa ka vun’winyi bya misava ku ri hava ndziriso.

src: E sale ka 1994 puso e dirile ka natla go busetsa morago letlotlo la go amogiwa lefatshe ka fa tlase ga bokolianale le tlhaolele.
tgt: Kusukela hi 1994 Mfumo wu tirhile hi matimba ku tlherisela endzhaku ndzhaka ya ku tekeriwa vun’winyi bya misava ehansi ka mfumo wa xikoloni na wa xihlawuhlawu.

src: Re dira go ya ka molao, puso e dirile go le gontsi go netefatsa gore lefatshe le tsweledisa tlhagiso, fa ka fa letlhakoreng le lengwe le itlhaganedisa tsamaiso ya go duela bao ba amilweng ke go amogiwa lefatshe.
tgt: Ku ri karhi ku tirhiwa hi ku landzelela nawu, mfumo wu endlile swo tala ku tiyisisa leswaku ku va na ntshovelo lowu yaka emahlweni wa misava, loko ku ri karhi ku hatlisisiwa endlelo ra ndzulamiso eka lava khumbekaka hi ku tekeriwa vun’winyi bya misava.

src: Ntlha eno e fetiseditswe kwa Komiting ya Tebosešwa ya Molaotheo, eo e tshwanetseng go begela Palamente ka 30 Phatwe 2018.
tgt: Mhaka leyi yi kongomisiwile eka Komiti ya Nkambisiso wa Vumbiwa, leyi yi faneleke ku vuyisa xiviko ePalamende hi kwalomu ka 30 Mhawuri 2018.

src: Dikatlenegiso go Kokoano Bosetšhaba di tla laelwa ke metseletsele ya ditheetso tsa setšhaba di salwa morago ke dikopano tsa komiti.
tgt: Swibumabumelo eka Huvo ya Rixaka swi ta leteriwa hi ntlhandlamano wa tinhlengeletano to twa miehleketo ya vaaki leti nga ta landzeriwa hi tinhlengeletano ta komiti.

src: Kabinete e ikuela go baamegi botlhe go dira ditshwaelo mo tsamaisong eno ya dipuisano, eo e tla kaelang ditshweetso tse di isang naga ya rona kwa pele.
tgt: Khabinete yi rhamba lava khumbhekaka hinkwavo ku nyika vonelo ra vona hi nkarhi wa endlelo lera mbulavurisano, leri ri nga ta letela switshunxo ku yisa tiko ra ka hina emahlweni.

src: Jaaka puso e e kgathalelang le go ikaega ka batho, baamegi botlhe ba tla nna le seabe ka nako ya tsamaiso eno.
tgt: Tanihi mfumo lowu hlayisaka na ku va wu simekiwe eka vanhu, lava khumbhekaka hinkwavo va ta vulavurisana hi nkarhi wa endlelo leri.

src: Kabinete e tswelela go kopa baagi go emisa go itseela lefatshe e se ka molao.
tgt: Khabinete yi ya emahlweni yi khutaza vaakandhawu ku sukela ku phanga misava loku nga riki enawini.

src: Re naga e e obamelang molao le go nna le kagiso ka mekgwa e e lekaneng ya go mekamekana le merero, go tsenyeletsa le morero wa lefatshe.
tgt: Hi tiko leri landzelelaka nawu na ku va ro rhandza ku rhula leri nga na maendlelo yo ringanela ku tirhana na swiphiqo, ku katsa na xiphiqo xa misava.

src: Aforika Borwa e tswelela go amogela kgwebo, mme dipeeletso go temothuo le temo di amogelesegile.
tgt: Afrika-Dzonga yi tshama yi pfulekile eka bindzu, naswona vuvekisi eka vurimi na vufuwi bya amukeriwa.

src: Ke mo dikgatlhegong tsa Aforika Borwa go nna le bagwebi ba balemi mme tsamaiso eno e ka netefatsa gore re nna le dipalo tse di kwa godimo tsa bagwebi ba balemi ba ba atlegileng.
tgt: Swi vuyerisa Afrika-Dzonga ku va na vafuwi va xibindzu naswona endlelo leri ri endla leswaku hi va na tinhlayo letikulu ta vafuwi va xibindzu lava humelelaka.

src: Porojeke ya Ikonomi ya Diphologo tse di Tlhaga ya Double Drift ya baagi ba Nofingxana.
tgt: Phurojeke ya Ikhonomi ya Swiharhi na Swimilana swa Nhova ya Double Drift ya muganga wa ka Nofingxana.

src: Kabinete e amogela go tlhomiwa ga Porojeke ya Ikonomi ya Diphologolo tse di Tlhaga ya Double Drift ya Baagi ba Nofingxana, kwa Serapeng sa Diphologolo sa Double Drift kwa Kapa Botlhaba ke Tona ya Merero ya Tikologo, Ng Edna Molewa.
tgt: Khabinete yi amukela ku simekiwa ka Phurojeke ya Ikhonomi ya Swiharhi na Swimilana swa Nhova ya Double Drift ya muganga wa ka Nofingxana eka Ntanga wa Ntumbuluko wa Double Drift eKapa-Vuxa hi Holobye wa Timhaka ta Mbango, Dok Edna Molewa.

src: Seno se tsenyeletsa go newa ga makwalokano a bonno go Mokgatlo wa Thototlhakanelwa wa Likhaya Lethu (CPA) mo boemong jwa Tona ya Tlhabololo ya Magae le Ntšhwafatso ya Mafatshe, Moh Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.
tgt: Leswi swi katse ku nyikiwa ka papila ra vun’winyi eka Likhaya Lethu Communal Property Association (CPA) hi ku yimela Holobye wa Nhluvukiso wa Matikoxikaya na Antswiso wa Misava, Man Maite Nkoana-Mashabane.

src: Baagi ba Double Drift ba ne ba tseelwa ditshwanelo tsa bona tsa boagi le phulo ke Molao wa Lefatshe wa 1913.
tgt: Muganga wa Double Drift a wu tekeriwile timfanelo ta vutshamo na madyelo ya swifuwo hi Nawu wa Misava wa 1913.

src: Ka 1994, baagi bano ba ne ba tsenya topo ya lefatshe eo e neng ya duelwa ka 2012, eo e neng ya tsala go tlhomiwa ga Likhaya Lethu CPLikhaya Lethu CPA e na le maloko a le 1 500 a baagi ba Double Drift mme e amogetse R6 milione go tswa kwa Lefapheng la Merero ya Tikologo go tlhama kgwebo ya ikonomi ya diphologolo tsa naga mo polaseng ya Naudeshoek (1 400 diheketara).
tgt: Hi 1994, muganga lowu wu nghensile xikoxo xa misava lexi tshamisekisiweke hi 2012, leswi heteleleke eka Likhaya Lethu CPA ku va yi tumbuluxiwa.

src: Tuelo e ne ya tsamaiswa ka Lefapha la Tlhabololo ya Magae le Ntšhwafatso ya Lefatshe.
tgt: Likhaya Lethu CPA yi vumbiwa 1 500 wa swirho swa Muganga wa Double Drift naswona yi kumile R6 wa timiliyoni kusuka eka Ndzawulo ya Timhaka ta Mbango ku hluvukisa ndzingeto wa bindzu ra ikhonomi ya swiharhi na swimilana swa nhova epurasini ra Naudeshoek (1 400 wa tihekitara).

src: Banka ya VBS Mutual Kabinete e utlwile kitsiso ya Banka ya Resefe ya Aforika Borwa malebana le Banka ya VBS Mutual.
tgt: Nxaviselano lowu wu tirhiwile hi Ndzawulo ya Nhluvukiso wa Matikoxikaya na Antswiso wa Misava.
